<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11419">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />11419 TKT - Low level</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11419">

This exception is a user-defined exception in the Ticket Validation Template Editor and is generated on import and edit of tickets. This exception notifies users if the imported or manually entered value is below the minimum level limit. If the Tank Level Fill % Required flag is checked and a minimum level is specified in the Ticket Validation Template Editor, this exception will be generated when the level falls below the specified minimum limit.

The tank level units specified in the [Tank Configuration \> Units & Options tab](../../../Tank%20Editor/Configuration/Tank%20Editor_Config%20-%20Units-Options%20Tab.md) are the units that are used for this validation.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexceptionExample MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exceptionExample MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11419 Examples">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Examples</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11419 Examples">

**Example 1:**

- Tank level unit: Inches
- Tank level minimum: 15

A gauge ticket is entered with a level of 2’ 0”. Because the tank level unit is inches, the gauge ticket is converted to 24 inches. This exceeds the tank level minimum of 15, so the exception is not generated.

**Example 2:**

- Tank level unit: Feet
- Tank level minimum: 15

A gauge ticket is entered with a level of 2’ 6”. Because the tank level unit is feet, the gauge ticket is converted to 2.5 feet. This is below the tank level minimum of 15, so the exception is generated.

</div>

</div>

Only the Gauge ticket type is associated with this exception.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11420">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />11420 TKT - High level</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11420">

This exception is a user-defined exception in the Ticket Validation Template Editor and is generated on import and edit of tickets. This exception notifies users if the imported or manually entered value is above the user-defined maximum level limit. If the Tank Level Fill % Required flag is checked and a maximum level is specified in the Ticket Validation Template Editor, this exception will be generated when the level exceeds the specified maximum limit.

The tank level units specified in the [Tank Configuration \> Units & Options tab](../../../Tank%20Editor/Configuration/Tank%20Editor_Config%20-%20Units-Options%20Tab.md) are the units that are used for this validation.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexceptionExample MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exceptionExample MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11420 Examples">

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11420 Examples">

**Example 1:**

- Tank level unit: Inches

A gauge ticket is entered with a level of 2’ 0”. Because the tank level unit is inches, the gauge ticket is converted to 24 inches. This exceeds the tank level maximum of 15, so the exception is generated.

**Example 2:**

- Tank level unit: Feet
- Tank level minimum: 15

A gauge ticket is entered with a level of 2’ 6”. Because the tank level unit is feet, the gauge ticket is converted to 2.5 feet. This is below the tank level maximum of 15, so the exception is not generated.

</div>

</div>

Only the Gauge ticket type is associated with this exception.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11421">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />11421 TKT - Low free water level</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11421">

This exception is a user-defined exception in the Ticket Validation Template Editor and is generated on import and edit of tickets. This exception notifies users if the imported or manually entered value is below the user-defined minimum free water level limit. If the Free Water Fill % Required flag is checked and a minimum level is specified in the Ticket Validation Template Editor, this exception will be generated when the level falls below the specified minimum limit.

The tank level units specified in the [Tank Configuration \> Units & Options tab](../../../Tank%20Editor/Configuration/Tank%20Editor_Config%20-%20Units-Options%20Tab.md) are the units that are used for this validation.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexceptionExample MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exceptionExample MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11421 Examples">

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11421 Examples">

**Example 1:**

- Tank level unit: Inches
- Free Water Fill % Min: 2

A gauge ticket is entered with a free water level of 1’ 0”. Because the tank level unit is inches, the free water level is converted to 12 inches. This exceeds the free water fill % level minimum of 2, so the exception is not generated.

**Example 2:**

- Tank level unit: Feet
- Free Water Fill % Min: 2

A gauge ticket is entered with a free water level of 1’ 6”. Because the tank level unit is feet, the free water level is converted to 1.5 feet. This is below the free water fill % level minimum of 2, so the exception is generated.

</div>

</div>

Only the Gauge ticket type is associated with this exception.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11477">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />11477 TKT - High movement level change</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11477">

This exception is a user-defined exception in the Ticket Validation Template Editor and is generated on import and edit of tank run tickets. This exception notifies users that the change in level from open to close is above the user-defined maximum movement level change limit. If the level change is specified in the Ticket Validation Template Editor, this exception will be generated when the level change exceeds the specified limit.

The tank level units specified in the [Tank Configuration \> Units & Options tab](../../../Tank%20Editor/Configuration/Tank%20Editor_Config%20-%20Units-Options%20Tab.md) are the units that are used for this validation.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexceptionExample MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exceptionExample MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11477 Examples">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Examples</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11477 Examples">

**Example 1:**

- Tank level unit: Inches
- Level change: 5

An open level of 0' 6" and a close level of 3' 0" are entered. Because the tank level unit is inches, the movement change is calculated as: 36" - 6" = 30". This result exceeds the level change limit of 5, so the exception is generated.

**Example 2:**

- Tank level unit: Feet
- Level change: 5

An open level of 0' 6" and a close level of 3' 0" are entered. Because the tank level unit is feet, the movement change is calculated as: 3' - .5' = 2.5'. This result is below the level change limit of 5, so the exception is not generated.

</div>

</div>

Only the Tank Run ticket type is associated with this exception.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11478">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />11481 TKT - Low open level</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11481">

This exception is a user-defined exception in the Ticket Validation Template Editor and is generated on import and edit of tickets. This exception notifies users if the imported or manually entered value is below the minimum open level limit. If the Tank Level Fill % Required flag is checked and a minimum level is specified in the Ticket Validation Template Editor, this exception will be generated when the open level falls below the specified minimum limit.

The tank level units specified in the [Tank Configuration \> Units & Options tab](../../../Tank%20Editor/Configuration/Tank%20Editor_Config%20-%20Units-Options%20Tab.md) are the units that are used for this validation.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexceptionExample MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exceptionExample MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11481 Examples">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Examples</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11481 Examples">

**Example 1:**

- Tank level unit: Inches
- Tank level minimum: 15

An open level of 2’ 0” is entered. Because the tank level unit is inches, the open level is converted to 24 inches. This exceeds the tank level minimum of 15, so the exception is not generated.

**Example 2:**

- Tank level unit: Feet
- Tank level minimum: 15

An open level of 2’ 6” is entered. Because the tank level unit is feet, the open level is converted to 2.5 feet. This is below the tank level minimum of 15, so the exception is generated.

</div>

</div>

Only the Tank Run ticket type is associated with this exception.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11482">

An open free water level of 1’ 0” is entered. Because the tank level unit is inches, the open free water level is converted to 12 inches. This exceeds the open free water fill % level maximum of 4, so the exception is generated.

**Example 2:**

- Tank level unit: Feet
- Free water fill % maximum: 4

An open free water level of 1’ 6” is entered. Because the tank level unit is feet, the open free water level is converted to 1.5 feet. This is below the open free water fill % level maximum of 4, so the exception is not generated.

</div>

</div>

Only the Tank Run ticket type is associated with this exception.

</div>
